hotels.title: Gold Coast Sports & Leisure Stay at Southport Entertainment Complex with Rooftop Bar & World-Class Fitness Facilities
hotels.description: Sitting in the heart of Southport's Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct, Mantra at Sharks is a modern four-star hotel with something genuinely different up its sleeve - direct access to the Southport Sharks entertainment complex. Such access puts an array of restaurants, bars, live events and one of the Gold Coast's finest fitness facilities right at your door. Up on the rooftop, Aviary Bar serves handcrafted cocktails and Italian-inspired share plates six floors above the city, with 360-degree views stretching across the Gold Coast skyline. Back at ground level, the Sharks complex offers multiple dining options spanning buffet dining at Frenzy's, Cabana Bar and the sports-focused Mackenzie's - with live DJs, karaoke and trivia nights keeping things lively after dark. The Sharks Health Club is a standout - a purpose-built facility with a full gym floor, free weights, functional training zones and a broad group fitness timetable, all complimentary for hotel guests during staffed hours.
